says: In next/, a child start finds its first letter by reading the child's whole inbox from position 0 and searching it for one id, where the ledger's UNIQUE (stream, id) index answers it in one read.
proof: ChildrenLedger.ts:61 runs [...turn.read(inbox(saved.name), 0)].find((e) => e.id === letterId(child.id)); turn.read is SELECT * FROM entries WHERE stream = ? AND rev > ? with no limit (ledger/internal/ledgerStore.ts:402).
cost: A restart of a long-lived child name reads every letter that name ever got, once per start; ticket 936's turn.get would make it one row.
